"“Replace” first deletes your current agents, chats, notes, alarms and routines."
"Write or dictate a note: agents can add notes too."
"The app records while you hold the button. On release, the audio is sent to Groq (api.groq.com) for transcription, then deleted from the device."

"user: %1$s\n\nCheck the address. You\'ll enter the password on the next screen."

"On the PC, set HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME, _PASSWORD and _SECRET (32+ random characters) in ~/.hermes/.env. Then run: hermes dashboard --host 0.0.0.0 --no-open. HTTP is allowed on a local network; use HTTPS outside it. The password is stored encrypted in the device Keystore."
"Hermes via Nous Portal (portal.nousresearch.com). Model names change between releases: check the portal."

"r1agents is a standalone app for Rabbit R1: talk to Claude, Hermes or any OpenAI-compatible service directly from the device, without a daemon or root.\n\nThe design, characters and many animations come from M4cs\'s r1os (MIT licence). Voice transcription uses Groq Whisper when you configure a key."
